description: This Java class defines an entity 'LoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMapping' that maps loan reschedule requests to loan term variations within the Fineract loan portfolio module. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, including relationships to 'LoanRescheduleRequest' and 'LoanTermVariations', and provides factory and accessor methods.

classes.name: LoanRescheduleRequestToTermVariationMapping
classes.description: Entity class that maps a loan rescheduling request to specific loan term variations, facilitating the management of loan schedule adjustments.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new mapping instance linking a loan reschedule request to a loan term variation.

methods.name: getLoanTermVariations
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the associated LoanTermVariations.

methods.name: getLoanRescheduleRequest
methods.description: Accessor method to retrieve the associated LoanRescheduleRequest.
